name: Figma
summary: Community Figma UI kits for shadcn/ui — free and paid options that recreate every component with props, theming and icons.
description: A shadcn/ui docs page listing community Figma kits: free options from Sitsiilia Bergmann, Pietro Schirano, Obra Studio and shadcncraft, and paid kits (Matt Wierzbicki, shadcncraft Pro, shadcn/studio, Shadcnblocks, Obra Pro, Shadcn Space, ShadcnStore) with variables, theming and design-to-code tooling.
